sources.title: First Census of Water Bodies, Maharashtra state return (data.gov.in resource e1874d07)
sources.publisher: Department of Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation, Ministry of Jal Shakti, via the Open Government Data Platform

provenance.note: First Census of Water Bodies rows for Akole taluka: 320 water bodies assigned to 96 Gram Panchayats through the LGD coverage register (the census locates each in a Census 2011 village; a village under exactly one Panchayat is assigned), rolled up per Panchayat (count, named count, type and ownership classes, a digest of the sorted names) with the enumerators' coordinates served as MultiPoint geometry under the Government Open Data License. 89 rows of the taluka are counted and not assigned (ext.atlas.unassigned: a village listed under two Panchayats, under none, a Census village with no LGD row, a town). Waterspread is withheld: The Ahmadnagar return shows the template pattern in a 1,200-row sample: 20 distinct whole-number waterspread values with 0 on a majority of rows and depth NA on half, an enumerator's default rather than a measurement, so the waterspread is not published. Counts, types, ownership and recorded coordinates are served. A Panchayat absent here has no row in the return.

conventions.geometry: MultiPoint of the recorded coordinates, five decimals, points outside the district's own bounding box dropped and counted in ext.atlas.pointsOutsideDistrict (a district total)
conventions.join: unique_id part 5 is the Census 2011 village code; the directory's LGD coverage register names the Panchayat; shared, uncovered and unknown villages and urban rows are counted in ext.atlas.unassigned, never pooled
conventions.holder: byDepartment carries the census ownership class (the register's holder axis); byType the census water-body class
conventions.vintage: reference years 2017-18 to 2020-21, published 2023; the portal's resource stamp is the edition watched
